BEGIN:VEVENT
CATEGORIES:HBO
DESCRIPTION:In Episode 6 of Lanterns: The Official Podcast\, host Juju Gre
 en breaks down “Bad Optics” with co-executive producer and writer Justin 
 Britt-Gibson and director Stephen Williams\, before sitting down with Gra
 mmy Award-winning composer Stephanie Economou to talk about the music beh
 ind the series. \n\nJuju\, Justin\, and Stephen get into John Stewart's r
 eturn to Rushville\, the show's 10-year time jump\, the evolution of Supe
 r Heroes in the DC Universe\, Hal Jordan's self-written eulogy\, and Nath
 an Fillion's scene-stealing take on Guy Gardner. \n\nThen\, Stephanie Eco
 nomou goes inside the creation of the Lanterns score\, from John Stewart

 , experimental sounds\, silence in Hal's funeral\, and the score's relati
 onship to the episode's final needle drop.
